exposure: Cardiac arrest during admissions for delivery
outcome: Incidence of maternal cardiac arrest during admissions for delivery
Characteristics and causes of cardiac arrest
Mortality rate and outcomes of maternal cardiac arrest
cohort: 23 women who experienced cardiac arrest during admissions for delivery at a referral, single-university, teaching hospital in Thailand
finding: The study found a high maternal mortality rate (86.9%) following cardiac arrest during hospitalization for delivery, with hypertension during pregnancy and cardiovascular causes being the most common reasons for the arrests.
mod_finding: One patient underwent a perimortem cesarean delivery in the operating theatre.
